notes: Flamingo is an unofficial fan reference map. It contains no game art, screenshots, music or map imagery from Rockstar Games: the map is drawn from scratch and every pin is a text label placed by hand from public trailers and press. The app name, icon and keywords contain no third-party trademarks; the description names the game publisher only in a not-affiliated disclaimer. Sign-in is optional; everything works without an account. Account deletion is in Settings > Account. The same app runs free on the web at flamingo.jaybulb.com.
